name: MPM Auto Route
description: Per-turn mode/persona auto-switching via `mpm route --apply`. Capture the user prompt, spawn MPM's router, inject the rendered <system-reminder> into SOUL.md. Requires MPM installed and on PATH (`/usr/local/bin/mpm` or `~/.local/bin/mpm`).

enabled.description: Master toggle. When false, the plugin is a complete no-op.

mpmBin.description: Path to the mpm binary. Default 'mpm' (resolves from PATH).
